verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֛ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ שֵׁנִ֑ית וְהוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ עָצ֔וּר בַּחֲצַ֥ר הַמַּטָּרָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū šê·nîṯ wə·hū ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ‘ā·ṣūr ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard the word of the LORD came to him a second time
verses.literalPt: E VEIO a palavra do SENHOR a Jeremias, segunda vez, estando ele ainda encarcerado no pátio da guarda, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עֹשָׂ֑הּ יְהוָ֗ה יוֹצֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֛הּ לַהֲכִינָ֖הּ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘ō·śāh Yah·weh yō·w·ṣêr ’ō·w·ṯāh la·hă·ḵî·nāh Yah·weh šə·mōw
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD who made the earth the LORD who formed it and established it the LORD is His name
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR que faz isto, o SENHOR que forma isto, para o estabelecer; o SENHOR é o seu nome.

verses.original: קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וְאֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ וְאַגִּ֧ידָה לְּךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּבְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: qə·rā ’ê·lay wə·’e·‘ĕ·ne·kā wə·’ag·gî·ḏāh lə·ḵā gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ṣu·rō·wṯ lō yə·ḏa‘·tām
verses.literal: Call to Me and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know
verses.literalPt: Clama a mim, e responder-te-ei, e anunciar-te-ei coisas grandes e firmes que não sabes.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל־ בָּתֵּי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְעַל־ בָּתֵּ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה הַנְּתֻצִ֕ים אֶל־ הַסֹּלְל֖וֹת וְאֶל־ הֶחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- bāt·tê hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·‘al- bāt·tê mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh han·nə·ṯu·ṣîm ’el- has·sō·lə·lō·wṯ wə·’el- he·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD the God of Israel says about the houses of this . . . city and the palaces of the kings of Judah that have been torn down for defense against the siege ramps . . . and the sword
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel, acerca das casas desta cidade, e das casas dos reis de Judá, que foram derrubadas com os aríetes e à espada.

verses.original: בָּאִ֗ים לְהִלָּחֵם֙ אֶת־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּלְמַלְאָם֙ אֶת־ פִּגְרֵ֣י הָאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הִכֵּ֥יתִי בְאַפִּ֖י וּבַחֲמָתִ֑י וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר הִסְתַּ֤רְתִּי פָנַי֙ מֵהָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את עַ֖ל כָּל־ רָעָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bā·’îm lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ’eṯ- hak·kaś·dîm ū·lə·mal·’ām ’eṯ- piḡ·rê hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer- hik·kê·ṯî ḇə·’ap·pî ū·ḇa·ḥă·mā·ṯî wa·’ă·šer his·tar·tî p̄ā·nay mê·hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ ‘al kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯām
verses.literal: The Chaldeans are coming to fight and to fill those places with the corpses of the men I will strike down in My anger and in My wrath I have hidden My face from this city because of all its wickedness
verses.literalPt: Eles entraram a pelejar contra os caldeus, mas isso é para os encher de cadáveres de homens, que feri na minha ira e no meu furor; porquanto escondi o meu rosto desta cidade, por causa de toda a sua maldade.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֧י מַעֲלֶה־ לָּ֛הּ אֲרֻכָ֥ה וּמַרְפֵּ֖א וּרְפָאתִ֑ים וְגִלֵּיתִ֣י לָהֶ֔ם עֲתֶ֥רֶת שָׁל֖וֹם וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ma·‘ă·leh- lāh ’ă·ru·ḵāh ū·mar·pê ū·rə·p̄ā·ṯîm wə·ḡil·lê·ṯî lā·hem ‘ă·ṯe·reṯ šā·lō·wm we·’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: Nevertheless I will bring to it health and healing and I will heal its people and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu trarei a ela saúde e cura, e os sararei, e lhes manifestarei abundância de paz e de verdade.

verses.original: וַהֲשִֽׁבֹתִי֙ אֶת־ שְׁב֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת שְׁב֣וּת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבְנִתִ֖ים כְּבָרִֽאשֹׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ’eṯ- šə·ḇūṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’êṯ šə·ḇūṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·ni·ṯîm kə·ḇā·ri·šō·nāh
verses.literal: I will restore Judah and Israel from captivity and will rebuild them as in former times
verses.literalPt: E removerei o cativeiro de Judá e o cativeiro de Israel, e os edificarei como ao princípio.

verses.original: וְטִ֣הַרְתִּ֔ים מִכָּל־ עֲוֺנָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ־ לִ֑י וְסָלַחְתִּ֗י לְכוֹל עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ־ לִ֔י וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭi·har·tîm mik·kāl ‘ă·wō·nām ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭə·’ū- lî wə·sā·laḥ·tî lə·ḵōl ‘ă·wō·nō·w·ṯê·hem ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭə·’ū- lî wa·’ă·šer pā·šə·‘ū ḇî
verses.literal: And I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me and will forgive all . . . their sins of rebellion against Me
verses.literalPt: E os purificarei de toda a sua maldade com que pecaram contra mim; e perdoarei todas as suas maldades, com que pecaram e transgrediram contra mim;

verses.original: וְהָ֣יְתָה לִּ֗י לְשֵׁ֤ם שָׂשׂוֹן֙ לִתְהִלָּ֣ה וּלְתִפְאֶ֔רֶת לְכֹ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁמְע֜וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַטּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽנֹכִי֙ עֹשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם וּפָחֲד֣וּ וְרָֽגְז֗וּ עַ֤ל כָּל־ הַטּוֹבָה֙ וְעַ֣ל כָּל־ הַשָּׁל֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָֽנֹכִ֖י עֹ֥שֶׂה לָּֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lî lə·šêm śā·śō·wn liṯ·hil·lāh ū·lə·ṯip̄·’e·reṯ lə·ḵōl gō·w·yê hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer yiš·mə·‘ū ’eṯ- kāl- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ō·śeh ’ō·ṯām ū·p̄ā·ḥă·ḏū wə·rā·ḡə·zū ‘al kāl- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh wə·‘al kāl- haš·šā·lō·wm ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ō·śeh lāh
verses.literal: So this city will bring Me renown joy praise and glory before all the nations of the earth who will hear of all the good I do for it They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness . . . and prosperity that I will provide for it
verses.literalPt: E este lugar me servirá de nome, de gozo, de louvor, e de glória, entre todas as nações da terra, que ouvirem todo o bem que eu lhe faço; e espantar-se-ão e perturbar-se-ão por causa de todo o bem, e por causa de toda a paz que eu lhe dou.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עוֹד֮ יִשָּׁמַ֣ע בַּמָּקוֹם־ הַזֶּה֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֔ים חָרֵ֣ב ה֔וּא מֵאֵ֥ין אָדָ֖ם וּמֵאֵ֣ין בְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְחֻצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הַֽנְשַׁמּ֗וֹת מֵאֵ֥ין אָדָ֛ם וּמֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב וּמֵאֵ֥ין בְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘ō·wḏ yiš·šā·ma‘ bam·mā·qō·wm- haz·zeh ’ă·šer ’at·tem ’ō·mə·rîm ḥā·rêḇ hū mê·’ên ’ā·ḏām ū·mê·’ên bə·hê·māh bə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·ḥu·ṣō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim han·šam·mō·wṯ mê·’ên ’ā·ḏām ū·mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ ū·mê·’ên bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says In this place you say is a wasteland . . . without man or beast in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted inhabited by neither man nor beast there will be heard again
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Neste lugar de que vós dizeis que está desolado, e sem homem, sem animal nas cidades de Judá, e nas ruas de Jerusalém, que estão assoladas, sem homem, sem morador, sem animal, ainda se ouvirá:

verses.original: ק֣וֹל שָׂשׂ֞וֹן וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֗ה ק֣וֹל חָתָן֮ וְק֣וֹל כַּלָּה֒ ק֣וֹל אֹמְרִ֡ים הוֹדוּ֩ אֶת־ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת כִּֽי־ ט֤וֹב יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֔וֹ מְבִאִ֥ים תּוֹדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי־ אָשִׁ֧יב אֶת־ שְׁבוּת־ הָאָ֛רֶץ כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: qō·wl śā·śō·wn wə·qō·wl śim·ḥāh qō·wl ḥā·ṯān wə·qō·wl kal·lāh qō·wl ’ō·mə·rîm hō·w·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ kî- ṭō·wḇ Yah·weh kî- lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw mə·ḇi·’îm tō·w·ḏāh bêṯ Yah·weh kî- ’ā·šîḇ ’eṯ- šə·ḇūṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ kə·ḇā·ri·šō·nāh ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: the sounds of joy and gladness the voices of the bride and bridegroom and the voices of those bringing thank offerings into the house of the LORD saying Give thanks to the LORD of Hosts for the LORD is good His loving devotion endures forever For I will restore the land from captivity as in former times says the LORD
verses.literalPt: A voz de gozo, e a voz de alegria, a voz do esposo e a voz da esposa, e a voz dos que dizem: Louvai ao SENHOR dos Exércitos, porque bom é o SENHOR, porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre; dos que trazem ofertas de ação de graças à casa do SENHOR; pois farei voltar os cativos da terra como ao princípio, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ ע֞וֹד יִֽהְיֶ֣ה׀ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה הֶחָרֵ֛ב מֵֽאֵין־ אָדָ֥ם וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֖ה וּבְכָל־ עָרָ֑יו נְוֵ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים מַרְבִּצִ֖ים צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘ō·wḏ yih·yeh bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh he·ḥā·rêḇ mê·’ên- ’ā·ḏām wə·‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh ū·ḇə·ḵāl ‘ā·rāw nə·wêh rō·‘îm mar·bi·ṣîm ṣōn
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says In this desolate place without man . . . or beast and in all its cities there will once more be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Ainda neste lugar, que está deserto, sem homem nem animal, e em todas as suas cidades, haverá uma morada de pastores, que façam repousar aos seus rebanhos.

verses.original: בְּעָרֵ֨י הָהָ֜ר בְּעָרֵ֤י הַשְּׁפֵלָה֙ וּבְעָרֵ֣י הַנֶּ֔גֶב וּבְאֶ֧רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֛ן וּבִסְבִיבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּבְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה עֹ֣ד תַּעֲבֹ֧רְנָה הַצֹּ֛אן עַל־ יְדֵ֥י מוֹנֶ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·‘ā·rê hā·hār bə·‘ā·rê haš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê han·ne·ḡeḇ ū·ḇə·’e·reṣ bin·yā·min ū·ḇis·ḇî·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ‘ōḏ ta·‘ă·ḇō·rə·nāh haṣ·ṣōn ‘al- yə·ḏê mō·w·neh ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: In the cities of the hill country the foothills and the Negev in the land of Benjamin and the cities surrounding Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah the flocks will again pass under the hands of the one who counts them says the LORD
verses.literalPt: Nas cidades das montanhas, nas cidades das planícies, e nas cidades do sul, e na terra de Benjamim, e nos contornos de Jerusalém, e nas cidades de Judá, ainda passarão os rebanhos pelas mãos dos contadores, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וַהֲקִֽמֹתִי֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֛רְתִּי אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haṭ·ṭō·wḇ ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ’el- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘al- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Behold the days are coming declares the LORD when I will fulfill the gracious promise that I have spoken to the house of Israel . . . and the house of Judah
verses.literalPt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que cumprirei a boa palavra que falei à casa de Israel e à casa de Judá;

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵם֙ וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא אַצְמִ֥יחַ לְדָוִ֖ד צֶ֣מַח צְדָקָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ha·hî ’aṣ·mî·aḥ lə·ḏā·wiḏ ṣe·maḥ ṣə·ḏā·qāh wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: In those days and at that time I will cause to sprout for David a righteous Branch and He will administer justice and righteousness in the land
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias e naquele tempo farei brotar a Davi um Renovo de justiça, e ele fará juízo e justiça na terra.

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵם֙ תִּוָּשַׁ֣ע יְהוּדָ֔ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן לָבֶ֑טַח וְזֶ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָא־ לָ֖הּ יְהוָ֥ה׀ צִדְקֵֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm tiw·wā·ša‘ yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim tiš·kō·wn lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·zeh ’ă·šer- yiq·rā- lāh Yah·weh ṣiḏ·qê·nū
verses.literal: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will dwell securely . . . and this is the name by which it will be called The LORD Our Righteousness
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias Judá será salvo e Jerusalém habitará seguramente; e este é o nome com o qual Deus a chamará: O SENHOR é a nossa justiça.

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֣ת לְדָוִ֔ד אִ֕ישׁ יֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lō- yik·kā·rêṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’îš yō·šêḇ ‘al- kis·sê ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Nunca faltará a Davi homem que se assente sobre o trono da casa de Israel;

verses.original: וְלַכֹּהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֥ת אִ֖ישׁ מִלְּפָנָ֑י מַעֲלֶ֨ה עוֹלָ֜ה וּמַקְטִ֥יר מִנְחָ֛ה וְעֹ֥שֶׂה־ זֶּ֖בַח כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim lō- yik·kā·rêṯ ’îš mil·lə·p̄ā·nāy ma·‘ă·leh ‘ō·w·lāh ū·maq·ṭîr min·ḥāh wə·‘ō·śeh- ze·ḇaḥ kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: nor will the priests who are Levites ever . . . fail to have a man before Me to offer burnt offerings to burn grain offerings and to present sacrifices
verses.literalPt: Nem aos sacerdotes levíticos faltará homem diante de mim, que ofereça holocausto, queime oferta de alimentos e faça sacrifício todos os dias.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū lê·mō·wr
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah . . .
verses.literalPt: E veio a palavra do SENHOR a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם־ תָּפֵ֙רוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וְאֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י הַלָּ֑יְלָה וּלְבִלְתִּ֛י הֱי֥וֹת יֽוֹמָם־ וָלַ֖יְלָה בְּעִתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’im- tā·p̄ê·rū ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî hay·yō·wm wə·’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî hal·lā·yə·lāh ū·lə·ḇil·tî hĕ·yō·wṯ yō·w·mām- wā·lay·lāh bə·‘it·tām
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says If you can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night so that day and night cease to occupy their appointed time
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Se puderdes invalidar a minha aliança com o dia, e a minha aliança com a noite, de tal modo que não haja dia e noite a seu tempo,

verses.original: גַּם־ בְּרִיתִ֤י תֻפַר֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔י מִהְיֽוֹת־ ל֥וֹ בֵ֖ן מֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־ כִּסְא֑וֹ וְאֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֥ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים מְשָׁרְתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: gam- bə·rî·ṯî ṯu·p̄ar ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî mih·yō·wṯ- lōw ḇên mō·lêḵ ‘al- kis·’ōw wə·’eṯ- hal·wî·yim hak·kō·hă·nîm mə·šā·rə·ṯāy
verses.literal: then My covenant may also be broken with David My servant and with My ministers the Levites who are priests so that David will not have a son to reign on his throne
verses.literalPt: Também se poderá invalidar a minha aliança com Davi, meu servo, para que não tenha filho que reine no seu trono; como também com os levitas, sacerdotes, meus ministros.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יִסָּפֵר֙ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְלֹ֥א יִמַּ֖ד ח֣וֹל הַיָּ֑ם כֵּ֣ן אַרְבֶּ֗ה אֶת־ זֶ֙רַע֙ דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔י וְאֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָׁרְתֵ֥י אֹתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer lō- yis·sā·p̄êr ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·ma·yim wə·lō yim·maḏ ḥō·wl hay·yām kên ’ar·beh ’eṯ- ze·ra‘ dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî wə·’eṯ- hal·wî·yim mə·šā·rə·ṯê ’ō·ṯî
verses.literal: As the hosts of heaven cannot be counted and as the sand on the seashore cannot be measured so too will I multiply the descendants of My servant David and the Levites who minister before Me
verses.literalPt: Como não se pode contar o exército dos céus, nem medir-se a areia do mar, assim multiplicarei a descendência de Davi, meu servo, e os levitas que ministram diante de mim.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah . . .
verses.literalPt: E veio ainda a palavra do SENHOR a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא רָאִ֗יתָ מָֽה־ הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ דִּבְּר֣וּ לֵאמֹ֔ר שְׁתֵּ֣י הַמִּשְׁפָּח֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּחַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בָּהֶ֖ם וַיִּמְאָסֵ֑ם וְאֶת־ עַמִּי֙ יִנְאָצ֔וּן מִֽהְי֥וֹת ע֖וֹד גּ֥וֹי לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w rā·’î·ṯā māh- hā·‘ām haz·zeh dib·bə·rū lê·mōr šə·tê ham·miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer bā·ḥar Yah·weh bā·hem way·yim·’ā·sêm wə·’eṯ- ‘am·mî yin·’ā·ṣūn mih·yō·wṯ ‘ō·wḏ gō·w lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: Have you not noticed what these people are saying . . . The LORD has rejected the two families He had chosen So they despise My people and no longer regard them as a nation
verses.literalPt: Porventura não tens visto o que este povo está dizendo: As duas gerações, que o SENHOR escolheu, agora as rejeitou? Assim desprezam o meu povo, como se não fora mais uma nação diante deles.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם־ לֹ֥א בְרִיתִ֖י יוֹמָ֣ם וָלָ֑יְלָה חֻקּ֛וֹת שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָ֖רֶץ לֹא־ שָֽׂמְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’im- lō ḇə·rî·ṯî yō·w·mām wā·lā·yə·lāh ḥuq·qō·wṯ šā·ma·yim wā·’ā·reṣ lō- śā·mə·tî
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says If I have not established My covenant with the day and the night and the fixed order of heaven and earth
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Se a minha aliança com o dia e com a noite não permanecer, e eu não puser as ordenanças dos céus e da terra,

verses.original: גַּם־ זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקוֹב֩ וְדָוִ֨ד עַבְדִּ֜י אֶמְאַ֗ס מִקַּ֤חַת מִזַּרְעוֹ֙ מֹֽשְׁלִ֔ים אֶל־ זֶ֥רַע אַבְרָהָ֖ם יִשְׂחָ֣ק וְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּֽי־ אָשׁוּב אֶת־ שְׁבוּתָ֖ם וְרִחַמְתִּֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: gam- ze·ra‘ ya·‘ă·qō·wḇ wə·ḏā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî ’em·’as miq·qa·ḥaṯ miz·zar·‘ōw mō·šə·lîm ’el- ze·ra‘ ’aḇ·rā·hām yiś·ḥāq wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî- ʾå̄·šūḇ ’eṯ- šə·ḇū·ṯām wə·ri·ḥam·tîm
verses.literal: then I would also reject the descendants of Jacob and of My servant David so as not to take from his descendants rulers over the descendants of Abraham Isaac and Jacob For I will restore them from captivity and will have compassion on them
verses.literalPt: Também rejeitarei a descendência de Jacó, e de Davi, meu servo, para que não tome da sua descendência os que dominem sobre a descendência de Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó; porque removerei o seu cativeiro, e apiedar-me-ei deles.
